features.info: Redraw applies to AMP Bank variable rate home loans only. You can access extra funds you’ve deposited at any time, with no withdrawal fees when using online banking, the AMP app, BankPhone or BankAssist. Minimum amounts and daily limits may apply.

Variable rate loans allow unlimited extra repayments, while fixed-rate loans often limit these to $10,000 per 12-month period. Please refer to Loan Conditions and Credit guide for more information on the consequences of repaying your Fixed Rate Loan early

Guarantor eligibility is subject to AMP Bank’s lending requirements and the guarantor’s financial position.
